{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the cleaned data
df_clean = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

df_clean = df_clean.drop(columns=['revenue_clean'])

# Now, compute conversion rate for each channel
total_email = (df_clean['channel'] == 'email').sum()
total_paid_search = (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search').sum()

converted_email = (df_clean['channel'] == 'email') & (df_clean['converted'] == 1)
converted_paid_search = (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df_clean['converted'] == 1)

conv_rate_email = converted_email.sum() / total_email
total_email
conv_rate_paid_search = converted_paid_search.sum() / total_paid_search

# Compute the difference: email minus paid_search
difference = conv_rate_email - conv_rate_paid_search

print(f'Email conversion rate: {conv_rate_email:.4f}')
print(f'Paid search conversion rate: {conv_rate_paid_search:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {difference:.4f}')"}
